reproduction_command: OKT_CLAIM_BENCH_LEVELS=1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 OKT_CLAIM_BENCH_WARMUPS=3 OKT_CLAIM_BENCH_BURSTS=30 OKT_CLAIM_BENCH_INVOCATIONS=5 OKT_CLAIM_BENCH_BOUNDARY_BURSTS=100 OKT_CLAIM_BENCH_OUT=.docs/internal/claim-next-agent-ceiling-reference.json go test ./internal/mcp -run '^$' -bench '^BenchmarkClaimNextAgentCeiling$' -benchtime=1x -count=1

protocol.tasks_per_burst: one newly seeded task per caller
correctness_oracle: zero duplicate, missing, foreign, empty, transport, tool, or decode claim results
one persisted assigned_to value matching the returning caller per seeded task
one task.assigned event with matching assignee per seeded task and no foreign assignment event
unchanged task bucket, plan, wave, and active state plus unchanged plan and wave rows
PRAGMA quick_check returns ok after every fresh-database invocation

pool.stack_shape: one sqlite.Store, agent.Service, and mcp.Adapter per caller
